name: Measure and mark craft material
short_description: Measure and mark craft material once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can measure and mark craft material in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Measure and mark craft material means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Measure and mark craft material in a fresh real-life scenario.
